text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"—So, to sum it up: 'concerns about 
interaction between old and new fans,' and 
'no increase in applications from new 
fans.' Those are the two issues, right?"

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "—Ah, there you are! Hey, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... Are you guys alright? I heard 
about the presentation. They made you do 
it over again, didn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, sister Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, if you'd like, tell me more about 
your presentation. I might be able to help 
out!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, I've got experience presenting 
since I've been on the organizing 
committee before! And McQueen gave me tips 
on how to appeal to the elders, too!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "! If that's the case—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"(...No, we cannot. We resolved to 
accomplish this with our own strength.)"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(We have to clear this hurdle without 
relying on Ryan's help. If we can't do 
that, we can't proudly say we've grown.)"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"—Sister Ryan. We are truly grateful for 
the offer. However, there is no need for 
your assistance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely going to see this 
through on our own. Just look forward to 
the actual event."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I see... Yeah... Got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"—...Well then... I'll be looking forward 
to it! Ah, but... if you ever need any 
help, don't hesitate to reach out, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
Wait...? Why... do I have this look on my 
face...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"—I've been thinking, let us first examine 
the issue of 'attracting new fans.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If we cannot envision what our 
prospective guests will look like, it will 
be difficult to formulate 
countermeasures."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"True. Reaching out to new demographics, 
huh... Maybe we should advertise more on 
social media? By posting more frequently 
than we currently do."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"We're already using Umastagram and 
Umattr, so... how about videos? Shall we 
try uploading videos of our races~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good! But if it's Twinkle Series 
race footage... I wonder. Some girls might 
have preconceived notions about that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A lot of the freestyle folks think of it 
as 'prim and proper racing.' They might 
not be very interested in watching..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Then... how about freestyle race videos? 
What if we ran in a freestyle race?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"For us to run... That might be a splendid 
idea. If we can deliver a performance that 
dispels everyone's preconceptions—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(A captivating, overwhelmingly thrilling 
performance that enchants everyone. 
............If it's her...!)'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(But............ could I really ask her? 
Someone so special in the Mejiro 
family............ when it's just someone 
like me...?)"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"(No... I'm supposed to show Ryan how much 
I've grown! In that case...!)'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I'll... run! And I'll go ask one more 
person... 
Someone who can run in a way that 
captivates everyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... Ramonu-san. 
I'm so sorry to call you out like this! 
Thank you for coming—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Your business? 
Keep it brief, please."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"............Please run with me! 
In a freestyle race...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"To show them our running. To dispel the 
preconceptions people have about the 
Mejiro family and get them interested!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You stand at the 'pinnacle' as a Triple 
Tiara winner, Ramonu-san. 
While you embody the Mejiro family more 
than anyone—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You also shine with a brilliance unlike 
anyone else in the Mejiros. Your running 
is thrilling... and I know it can 
captivate countless people!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I, too... was captivated by and came to 
admire your running... and that's why I 
chose to pursue this same path."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Please! I want to invite new fans to the 
'Mejiro Christmas Night'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
—A strong gaze. That, too, is a flame of 
love."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Very well. I shall participate. 
In return, do ensure you enrapture me with 
that flame of yours."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes, ma'am! 
...T-Thank you so much!!"
